entities.summary: Fredrik Claesson, is a Swedish professional ice hockey defenceman currently playing for HC Dynamo Moscow in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was drafted by the Ottawa Senators in the fifth round of the 2011 NHL draft.
